newsitem.title: USA: P.T. Pasifik launches telephony program.
newsitem.headline: P.T. Pasifik launches telephony program.

text.p: P.T. Pasifik Satelit Nusantara said Thursday it launched its new telecommunications service, Xpress Connection, to offer rural telephony in Indonesia.
The service, developed jointly with a unit of Titan Corp, uses small lightweight terminals that can be used with solar power systems when other power sources are unavailable.

The target for the country's development plan is to provide telecommunications by year's end in every municipality that has more than 3,700 people. The company said its program will be implemented by Telkom and PSN through Telsatindo, a joint venture company.
